question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Schwab supports newer/younger investors with accessible products such as Schwab Stock Slices and the Schwab Starter Kit, alongside trading capabilities, advisory solutions, and educational resources, with 24/7 multichannel support.
items.quote: We support newer investors with accessible products such as Schwab Stock Slices® and the Schwab Starter Kit®, alongside a comprehensive set of trading capabilities, advisory solutions, and educational resources.

items.text: Schwab offers the Schwab Teen Investor Account to serve younger investors.
items.quote: Schwab Teen Investor TM Account

items.text: Schwab positioned its offering to younger investors through thinkorswim, digital capabilities, and extensive live educational content (35 hours a week), plus crypto as additive.
items.quote: what we can offer the young investor in terms of the support, the service, the education, and of course, the leading platform with thinkorswim and our digital capabilities, I think is unmatched.

items.text: Schwab offers no/low commissions and the Schwab Starter Kit and Schwab Teen Investor Account for younger investors.
items.quote: Younger investors | Schwab Starter Kit TM | Schwab Teen Investor TM Account | No / low commissions

items.text: Schwab launched spot crypto trading (Schwab Crypto) with direct access to Bitcoin and Ethereum, combined with educational content and professional support, appealing to younger investors.
items.quote: Schwab Crypto TM 24 / 7 Crypto Futures ... fractional Trading Schwab Teen Investor TM Account

items.text: Schwab launched Schwab Crypto providing retail clients direct access to Bitcoin and Ethereum trading, with educational content and professional support.
items.quote: the Company provides clients direct access to bitcoin and ether trading, combined with educational content and professional support with investment experience.

items.text: Schwab offers fractional trading (Schwab Stock Slices) and fractional trading capability.
items.quote: Fractional Trading

items.text: Schwab provides advisory solutions with minimum investments starting at $5,000 via Schwab Wealth Advisory, providing financial planning and portfolio management.
items.quote: offers both discretionary and non-discretionary services, with minimum investments starting at $5,000. Our flagship program, Schwab Wealth Advisory™, provides a dedicated Wealth Advisor supported by a team of professionals offering financial planning, specialized support, and customized portfolio management.

items.text: Schwab offers self-directed digital/software trading platforms, real-time data, research tools, and Schwab Trading Powered by Ameritrade with the thinkorswim suite and 24/7 support.
items.quote: Schwab provides robust digital and software based trading platforms, real-time market data, research tools, and multichannel support... Schwab Trading Powered by Ameritrade® offers access to the thinkorswim® suite, along with specialized education and 24/7 support.

items.text: Schwab offers educational resources including articles, videos, podcasts, courses, live events, Schwab Equity Ratings, Schwab Network, and the Schwab Trading Activity Index.
items.quote: Educational resources include articles, videos, podcasts, interactive courses, live events, and tools such as Schwab Equity Ratings®.

items.text: Schwab launched Portfolio Insights, a generative AI-powered capability that helps investors understand portfolio performance, and an Investor AI Assistant.
items.quote: Introduced Portfolio Insights, a generative AI-powered capability that helps investors understand portfolio performance

items.text: Schwab introduced Charley, a new AI-powered assistant providing U.S. retail clients conversational access to Schwab's tools and insights.
items.quote: Introduced Charley, a new AI-powered assistant that provides U.S. retail clients with conversational access to Schwab's tools and insights

items.text: Schwab offers Schwab Private Client Services and Schwab Private Wealth Services for higher-net-worth clients, with dedicated service teams and relationship-based experiences.
items.quote: Schwab Private Client Services™ (for clients with $1 million to $10 million in qualifying assets) and Schwab Private Wealth Services™ (for clients with more than $10 million) provide enhanced, relationship-based experiences

items.text: Schwab provides wealth services including Advisor ProDirect, Family Wealth Alliance, UHNW solutions, and DAFgiving360 for donor-advised funds.
items.quote: Wealth Services: Advisor ProDirect, Family Wealth Alliance, UHNW solutions, DAFgiving360

items.text: Schwab enriched its wealth offer with financial planning, full-service advice, tax, trust, and estate services, and tax-aware strategies.
items.quote: clients can access financial planning, full-service advice, tax, trust, and estate services, tax-aware strategies, and more.

items.text: Schwab took an ownership stake in Wealth.com and began rolling out AI-powered estate planning tools to clients (Ester tax and estate planning tool).
items.quote: We took an ownership stake in Wealth.com and began rolling out their estate analysis capability to our specialists

items.text: Schwab launched Advisor ProDirect, a subscription service supporting RIAs in their journey to separately managed accounts.
items.quote: we launched Advisor ProDirect, a subscription service supporting RIAs wherever they are in their journey to separately managed accounts program

items.text: Schwab offers access to alternatives and private markets, including acquiring Forge (private market platform) and a strategic investment in Carta for equity management of pre-IPO private companies.
items.quote: We entered a definitive agreement to acquire Forge, which will help us provide clients with multiple ways to access alternatives while democratizing private investing.

items.text: Schwab offers Workplace Services including Retirement Plan Services, Stock Plan Services, and Schwab Private Issuer Equity Services for pre-IPO private companies, introducing new clients to Schwab.
items.quote: Retirement Plan Services offers a range of bundled retirement plan product types... Stock Plan Services offers stock plan administrators full-service recordkeeping... Introduced in late 2025, Schwab Private Issuer Equity Services

items.text: Schwab's wealth, banking, trading, and asset management offers span self-directed and advised solutions, proprietary and third-party products, alternatives, and digital assets.
items.quote: Self-directed & Advised Solutions | Banking | Trading | Proprietary & 3rd Party Products | Alternative & Private Investments | Digital Assets | Advice, Tax, Trust, & Estate

cells.reason: Multiple passages directly state products, services and platforms Schwab offers to attract and serve next-generation clients (Schwab Starter Kit, Stock Slices, Teen Investor Account, crypto, thinkorswim, digital experiences, advisory and estate planning tools).
